{{MissingInfo|2|java|enva}} [[File:Simeon.png|thumb|180px|Simeon]] '''Simeon''' (Japanese: '''シオザキ''' ''Shiozaki'') is a minor recurring character in {{aniseries|PTS}}. He first appeared in ''[[BW090|Jostling for the Junior Cup!]]'', where he participated in the [[Pokémon World Tournament Junior Cup]] and was [[Horatio]]'s first opponent. However, he was defeated by him and eliminated from the tournament. He made a cameo appearance in ''[[BW093|Goodbye, Junior Cup - Hello Adventure!]]'', where he lined up with all the other competitors in front of [[Alder]], [[Cynthia]], [[Caitlin]] and [[Freddy O'Martian]]. ==Pokémon== {{TrainerPoké |width=68% |trainer=Simeon |pkmn=Zebstrika |img=Simeon Zebstrika.png |type1=Electric |epnum=BW090 |epname=Jostling for the Junior Cup! |desc={{p|Zebstrika}} is the only Pokémon Simeon is known to have on hand. It was used in the first round of the Junior Cup but lost to Horatio's {{DL|Horatio|Cinccino}}. None of Zebstrika's moves are known.}} ==Pokémon competitions== Simeon has competed in the following {{cat|Pokémon competitions}}: * [[Pokémon World Tournament Junior Cup]] - Top 16 (''[[BW090|Jostling for the Junior Cup!]]'')
